notes.title: Update 5 - Screen resolution fix
notes.notes: The problem with the incorrect display resolution was fixed. In full screen mode, the screen of the game was displayed incorrectly on screens with an aspect ratio different from 16 to 9.

notes.title: Update 4 - More challenge in Fly mode
notes.notes:
Fix List:
- Added Random Spawn of peas in Fly Mode
- Rebalanced Fly Mode
- Added detailed tutorial in main game mode
- Small changes in Main Menu
- Fixed some small bugs

notes.title: Many Patches - Less Bugs
notes.notes:
It's been less than 5 days since release and our team has fixed a lot of bugs. 

List of important fixes: 
1) Repaired secret and casual endings of zombie mode 
2) Repaired Zombie Best Friend achivement. If you entered the secret door you were not able to get achievement. 
3) Reduced time of ending credits of Zombie Mode 
4) Fixed endless animation of medical ass fart in a room with the hell enter. 
5) Fixed some missed translation to russian 
6) Fixed Skunk fart collider in MSF 
7) Fixed the alarm timer in MSF on the first level 
8) Fixed a soldier attack in the second alarm in MSF 
9) Fixed some language mistakes 
10) And some other stuff 

If you find some bugs, please contact us, we really want our game to be more quality one.

notes.title: Fart Simulator 2018 came out!
